title: Integer-module etale sheaves and abelian etale sheaves are equivalent
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the functor from sheaves of modules over ULift Z on X_et to abelian sheaves on X_et, obtained by composing with the ordinary coefficient forgetful functor, is an equivalence. Here both are functor-valued etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], rather than modules over a sheaf of rings.

proof.text: The forgetful functor from ULift Z-modules to abelian groups is full and faithful: additive maps commute with integer scalar multiplication. Lift an abelian sheaf map sectionwise through that functor; faithfulness proves naturality. This proves fullness and faithfulness on sheaves.

Apply the inverse equivalence on coefficients to an abelian sheaf. Since an equivalence preserves limits it preserves the sheaf condition, so this gives a module sheaf. The coefficient counit induces a natural isomorphism from its underlying abelian sheaf to the original sheaf. Thus the sheaf functor is essentially surjective and hence an equivalence.
